name: Regolith ore processor
brief: MK-007 Regolith ore processor. A hopper you can tip dust into, a panelled furnace body on legs, a chute that drops bricks of sintered regolith onto a tray, an exhaust stack and a status lamp. Diegetic: the warm window glows while it cooks, the stack puffs slow low-gravity dust, and bricks pile up on the tray.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
